title: Strengthen review contracts and add AL reliability guidance
summary: Five new AL reliability rules are added with good/bad code samples covering data handling, security, testing, and web service integration, alongside framework improvements for deterministic review execution and layered rule precedence.
key_points: Five new source-backed AL reliability rules added: base quantity derivation, SetFilter concatenation security, test isolation, JSON null checking, and standard format usage for external data exchange
Review framework hardened with deterministic super-skill resolution, fallback logic for layered overrides, and findings report validation
Good/bad AL sample pairs provided for all new rules with routing keywords and evaluation fixtures
Layered action-skill overrides now follow documented custom > community > microsoft precedence deterministically
Comprehensive testing added including skill index validation, review contract enforcement, and knowledge retrieval verification
quote: Adds five source-backed rules, each with focused good/bad AL samples, routing keywords/checks, and deterministic evaluation coverage
